obligations.text: Profile revision 22 replaces revision 21 while the exact spec-spine pin is =0.32.0, the ordinary Rust code gate, corpus attestation and spec DAG remain required, the supply chain check is carried by the profile's required supply-chain job, and the derived directory stays at .derived/.

record.summary: Authorizes the migration from Statecraft github-actions-rust revision 21 to revision 22 together with the exact spec-spine pin move from 0.31.0 to 0.32.0. Revision 22's producer links spec-spine-core 0.32.0 and refuses any other pin, so the two moves land together. Revision 22 adds four required jobs (supply chain, workflow lint, ast-grep scan, secret scan); its supply chain job replaces the project's extra job of the same name. Aicortex keeps its ordinary Rust code gate and the corpus attestation and spec DAG jobs.
record.title: Adopt Statecraft profile revision 22 with spec-spine pinned at 0.32.0
